summary: Newtonsoft Json.NET wrapper for data JsonUtility cannot serialize.
overview: Use this instead of SaveSystem when the data has Dictionaries, interfaces or polymorphic types — the things Unity's built-in JsonUtility silently drops. Kept as its own tool so SaveSystem stays dependency-free.
Requires the Newtonsoft Json package: Window > Package Manager > Add package by name > com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json.
useCases: Saving a Dictionary keyed by id without flattening it into parallel lists.
Serializing a list holding several subclasses through a base type.
Talking to an external API or data file that already uses real JSON.

gotchas.title: It needs a package that is not installed by default
gotchas.body: Without com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json the file does not compile. That is the trade for handling types JsonUtility cannot.

gotchas.title: Polymorphism needs type information in the file
gotchas.body: Round-tripping a base-typed list only works if the settings write type names. Reading such a file from an untrusted source is a known risk in every JSON library.
